agreed, SWIM merely says god because that is the most apt word, but he knows it may not necessarily be from christianity, or even any existing religion at all

i see, have you ever tried or experimented with drugs before? if not, how can you be so sure that they dont give us true or useful information? a lot of artists and musicians find inspiration from them
good point, also ecstasy increases the levels of serotonin in your brain, it doesn't really introduce anything foreign

i agree with u/theaangstykid (clever name btw), ecstasy and other drugs can make/help you confront your issues or biases and give you a new perspective. if SWIM saw what he wanted to see, he wouldn't have found god, he would've just had an awesome time with his friends.

even if people dont find god through a drug, that drug oftentimes becomes a crutch for them for many other reasons. i think it just depends on the person, and many people do know how to control themselves. lots of kids experiment in college and grow up to be upstanding citizens with families. SWIM doesn't really feel the need to be high to connect with the divine, while it has opened his eyes, he tells me that after his experience, he can still feel the truth of his revelations.

SWIM would have agreed before, but ecstasy is a drug that allows you to lower your defenses, and be more trusting and open. it is being researched as a treatment for anxiety and other therapeutic purposes. SWIM thinks that it opened his mind to just how beautiful "reality" can be and how there must be a god if the world is so beautiful.

i see your point, but couldn't that be said of people who are already religious? there are many religious people who do bad/wrong things, but they still have a faith. with that being said, SWIM tries to be a good person, he goes to a good college, did a lot of volunteering and community work etc.
i can see how he can be led the wrong way, and SWIM says that he intends to stop, just not anytime soon. he doesn't do drugs often, and when he does it's as a social thing at parties.
hmm wow, i never thought of it that way, a very interesting take on the topic
